text.title: Amazon, grocery: Whole Foods Market deal, June 2017
text.pen: N/A: the press release gives no figures on Amazon's existing grocery sales
text.dev_p: N/A: not described in the press release
text.dev_m: N/A: not described in the press release
text.div: Buy Whole Foods Market, a natural and organic grocery chain: about $16 billion sales in fiscal 2016, 460+ stores in the US, Canada and the UK. $42 per share in cash, about $13.7 billion with net debt
text.choice: Diversification: the release does not name the matrix, the quadrant is our reading
text.decision: 16 June 2017: agreement to acquire. Whole Foods keeps its brand, John Mackey stays CEO, headquarters stay in Austin. Closing expected in the second half of 2017 after shareholder and regulatory approval
